purpose: Authoring-only side-by-side review of current course-native figures and ChatGPT-generated candidates.

items.title: Integrated nervous and endocrine control
items.scienceReview: Pass. Correctly separates fast neural and slower endocrine delivery, restricts hormone response to receptor-bearing cells, and closes the negative-feedback loop.

items.title: Nervous and endocrine control comparison
items.scienceReview: Pass. Uses qualified timing language and accurately distinguishes membrane-voltage and synaptic delivery from hormone transport in blood.

items.title: Sensory, interneuron, and motor neuron roles
items.scienceReview: Pass. Shows the correct receptor-to-CNS-to-effector information pathway without tying each functional class to one universal morphology.

items.title: Myelin and saltatory conduction
items.scienceReview: Pass. Distinguishes regeneration at nodes from continuous regeneration along an unmyelinated axon and shows local current under myelin.

items.title: Synaptic transmission
items.scienceReview: Pass. Correctly sequences action-potential arrival, calcium entry, vesicle fusion, receptor binding, reuptake, and enzymatic breakdown.

items.title: Sensory receptor families
items.scienceReview: Pass. Includes photoreceptors, mechanoreceptors, chemoreceptors, thermoreceptors, nociceptors, and proprioceptors with a shared transduction concept.

items.title: Retina and light pathway
items.scienceReview: Pass after revision. The corrected version separates retinal layers and shows incoming light and outgoing neural signals in opposite directions.

items.title: Vestibular apparatus and equilibrium
items.scienceReview: Pass after two revisions. Canal-cupula sensing is separated from utricle-saccule otolith sensing, and equilibrium integrates vestibular, visual, and proprioceptive evidence.

items.title: Rapid and slower stress-response pathways
items.scienceReview: Pass with wording cleanup recommended. The medulla and cortex pathways are distinct and cortisol feedback is shown, but 'return to baseline' should become 'return toward a workable range' before learner use.

items.title: Integrated regulation under changing conditions
items.scienceReview: Pass after revision. Osmoreceptors and volume/pressure receptors are separated, and ADH synthesis, posterior-pituitary release, and kidney action are correctly sequenced. Full-size label readability still needs review.
